Hey girl!! This is a patient asking for free treatment! 😡😡

When I took it out, it still hurt when I touched it. I was worried that there would be problems if I went back.)
The doctor then had the assistant get a new grinding head and said to me, "Wait a minute," in a harsh tone. Anyone hearing that would definitely feel uncomfortable, like they were unhappy that I asked for corrections multiple times.
Excuse me, wasn't it good that I told you then? If there had been problems later, I would have had to waste time coming back again.
***Please try to be more helpful in treating patients. You can't even say "yes" or "no" properly.***
